latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "paper-to-tools" skill.
- Paste a paper abstract or methods section to get matched AI agent tools for reproducing analysis.
- Maps methodology keywords to 131+ curated science agents from the Claw4Science directory.
- Provides concise agent recommendations with installation instructions and links.
- Supports a wide range of science domains, including genomics, drug discovery, clinical data, and research automation.
